audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Vayne Levels 2, 3 and First item while the whys underneath said the exact opposite (W root is your first threat window, Seraph's swings the lane to you). Level 1 was 'Skill' while whys[0] said she wins every level-1 exchange.
audit.why: Ryze's threat starts at W (level 2, root only through Flux) and peaks on mana items; Vayne's percent-HP true damage reclaims the duel at two items. The packet chart agrees and the 53.3% win rate agrees.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Ryze, Ryze, Skill, Skill, Ryze, Vayne — proposed as paired full/content rows with matching ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text claimed 'Vayne has no escape tool at this range' at levels 2-3.
audit.why: Tumble (Q) is available from level 1 on a 6/5/4/3/2s cooldown, and Condemn (E) knocks you back on 20/18/16/14/12s. She has two.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real constraint: Tumble only moves her 300 units, so a Fluxed W root catches her — but W without Flux only slows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors: 'Tumble Q through your W root' (a root cannot be dashed out of), and no mention that Ryze's W only roots if Flux is already on the target. The Tumble auto-reset tell was absent entirely.
audit.why: Ryze W states plainly: it damages and slows, and only roots if the target has Flux. Vayne's Tumble is an auto-attack reset, so the burst tell is the attack wind-up, not a cast animation. Silver Bolts procs on the third consecutive attack OR ability against the same target — abilities count.
audit.corrected: Stated the Flux-before-W ordering, corrected the foe want to 'Tumble out before your Flux lands so W only slows', and wrote the auto-reset tell into the Don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags zero sequencing cues; no cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Condemn's 20s rank-1 cooldown is the whole step-up clock, and Tumble's 6s rank-1 cooldown is the trade clock.

audit.whatIsWrong: TL;DR used male pronouns for Vayne ('His dash beats your root').
audit.why: Wrong-gender text reads as copy-paste and undermines trust in the rest of the page.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to her, and to the real mechanic.

edits.after: Silver Bolts procs on her third hit — farm at Q range, bank Manaflow, and give her no chain.

edits.before: W root threatens jungle follow-up, but it's also your kite tool — spending it greedily is how you die.
edits.after: Tumble is a 6-second auto-reset at rank 1 — its wind-up is your cue. Flux her, then W roots.

edits.before: Seraph's online — you out-DPS and out-tank everyone in extended fights. Side-lane and Warp to every fight.
edits.after: Seraph's is huge, but Silver Bolts' percent-HP true damage ignores your bulk — Warp to fights, don't duel.

edits.before: W root comes online and your empowered Q threatens a chunking punish — Vayne has no dash answer at level 2, giving you the first genuine threat window.
edits.after: W comes online and your empowered Q punishes hard — Tumble only carries her 300 units, so a Fluxed W roots her inside her own step-up window.

edits.before: W root into empowered Q is your first real threat — Vayne has no escape tool at this range and you punish any walk-up she makes to auto you.
edits.after: W root into empowered Q is your first real threat — Flux her first or W only slows, and Tumble's 300 units will not carry her out of the root.

edits.before: Auto you with Silver Bolts three times to proc percent-max-HP true damage before your W root is even relevant
edits.after: Land three consecutive hits — autos or abilities both count — to proc Silver Bolts' percent-max-HP true damage

edits.before: Tumble Q through your W root and kite back with her natural ranged advantage until Silver Bolts shred your HP pool
edits.after: Tumble away before your Flux lands so W only slows her, then kite back until Silver Bolts shreds your HP pool

edits.before: Wall-stun — never fight her with terrain at your back. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Wall-stun — never fight with terrain behind you. Condemn is down 20s at rank 1; go then.

edits.before: Vayne spends Condemn early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Vayne spends Condemn early — your root owns the next twenty seconds of lane.

edits.before: That’s Vayne’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Her burst opens with a Tumble auto-reset — the wind-up is the tell, not a cast.

notes: Condemn is a blockable projectile per the kit, which does not matter here — Ryze has no blocker, so nothing was written about it. Final Hour grants invisibility during Tumble; that is a late-game skirmish fact and there was no in-band slot for it without displacing a better one, so it is left for a future pass. Rows 3 and 4 of the chart were already 'Skill' in both layers and were left alone rather than invent a power shift.
